Step-by-Step Application Instructions

Follow these 6 numbered steps for seamless, natural grey hair coverage in just 10 minutes:

  1. Step 1: 48-Hour Patch Test & Cleansing

    Perform a 48-hour patch test before each application. Make sure your beard is dry and clean from any heavy beard waxes, pomades, or leave-in serums.

  2. Step 2: Equal 1:1 Mixing Ratio

    Squeeze equal quantities of 003 Dark Brown Colourant Cream and Developer Cream into the mixing tray. Mix thoroughly with the applicator brush until you see a rich, uniform consistency.

  3. Step 3: Start at Coarsest Grey Hair

    Apply the mixed cream using the brush side, concentrating first on the areas with the most visible grey whiskers—usually the chin and sideburn bases.

  4. Step 4: Distribute Through Moustache & Beard

    Comb through the rest of the beard and mustache with the comb teeth, ensuring the cream penetrates through the full depth of your facial hair.

  5. Step 5: Allow 10 Minutes to Process

    Wait exactly 10 minutes. The non-drip botanical formulation will coat every follicle without running down your neck or clothing.

  6. Step 6: Rinse with Water Until Clear

    Rinse thoroughly under lukewarm running water until the runoff is clear. Pat dry with a dark towel to reveal a deep, rich dark brown beard with healthy sheen.

Application Advisory: Always follow the instructions provided on the packaging for best results.

Precautions & 48-Hour Patch Test Protocol

Read and follow all safety precautions to safeguard your facial skin:

Critical 48-Hour Allergy Patch Test Instructions

  1. Wash a small area (approx. 1 cm²) behind the ear or on the inner forearm using water and gentle soap, then pat dry.
  2. Mix a pea-sized amount of 003 Dark Brown Colourant Cream with an equal amount of Developer Cream.
  3. Dab the mixture onto the prepared test area and allow it to dry completely. Leave uncovered for 48 hours.
  4. If any itching, stinging, redness, swelling, or irritation occurs within 48 hours, rinse immediately and do not apply the product.

Important Safety Warnings

  • Do not use if you have had an adverse reaction to hair dyes or beard colouring products in the past.
  • Never apply to skin that is inflamed, irritated, broken, freshly shaved, or has active skin conditions.
  • Avoid contact with the eyes. If cream gets into eyes, rinse immediately with large amounts of cool water and seek medical assistance.
  • Exclusively intended for beard, mustache, and sideburn hair. Never use on eyelashes or eyebrows.
  • Store in a cool, dry place away from heat and direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of children and pets.

Frequently Asked Questions: Dark Brown

Detailed answers to common questions about Dailyfix Dark Brown beard colour:

Q: Who is Dailyfix 003 Dark Brown Beard Colour best suited for?

A: 003 Dark Brown is ideal for men with naturally medium-to-dark brown facial hair, or those whose black beards have lighter, sun-bleached tones. It gives a warm, espresso-tinted finish that looks authentic and prevents the beard from looking overly dark.

Q: Will 003 Dark Brown lighten my naturally black beard hair?

A: No. Ammonia-free beard colours deposit pigment rather than bleaching or stripping melanin. 003 Dark Brown coats grey and lighter whiskers in rich espresso tones while blending seamlessly into darker hairs, creating a multi-tonal, natural look.

Q: Does 003 Dark Brown provide complete coverage on stubborn white chin hair?

A: Yes, Dailyfix 003 Dark Brown is formulated to deeply penetrate thick, wire-like grey and white facial hair cuticles. In just 10 minutes, it provides uniform, undetectable coverage that restores your beard’s natural density.

Q: How does Dailyfix prevent Dark Brown from turning brassy after multiple washes?

A: We formulate our dark brown shade with balanced cool-espresso undertones that resist ultraviolet breakdown and repeated face washing, ensuring your beard retains its sophisticated dark coffee hue without turning copper or brassy orange.

Q: Is 003 Dark Brown free from ammonia and harsh chemical smells?

A: Yes, Dailyfix 003 Dark Brown is 100% ammonia-free. There are no eye-watering fumes or burning odors during mixing or application, making your 10-minute at-home grooming ritual comfortable and pleasant.

Q: Can I apply beard balm or mustache wax after colouring with Dark Brown?

A: Yes. We suggest waiting 24 hours after your colouring session to allow the micro-pigments to completely set within the hair shaft. After that, you can resume your usual beard grooming routine, including balm, wax, and beard oil.

Q: How do I perform the mandatory 48-hour patch test for Dark Brown?

A: Mix a pea-sized drop of Colourant Cream and Developer Cream, apply it to a small patch of skin behind your ear or on your inner forearm, and let it dry. Leave it undisturbed for 48 hours. If no redness, burning, or rash occurs, you are ready to colour your beard.
